run_auto_generate_examples: run the script to process README.md files from examples/gke, cloud-run, and vertex-ai/notebooks into MDX docs
process_readme_files: process README.md files from examples/gke, cloud-run, and vertex-ai/notebooks directories into MDX format
process_file: process a single README.md file and convert it to MDX with transformed image paths and admonition blocks
transform_notebook_metadata: remove HTML comment wrappers from Jupyter notebook YAML frontmatter in README files
convert_admonition_blocks: convert markdown NOTE and WARNING admonition blocks into MDX Tip and Tip warning components
